'''Gorn Sweevas''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] slave of an [[Gorn Sweevas's master|Imperial military interrogator]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. In [[3643 BBY]] Sweevas was with his master on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], where he was interrogating Republic spies. One of the spies used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to kill all Imperials, including Sweevas' master. Sweevas himself escaped to safety and asked another Imperial to come into the lab and kill the freed prisoners.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Gorn Sweevas appears in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as an NPC on Nar Shaddaa and starts the Heroic mission "Botched Interrogation."
